title: Lion
wikitext:
'''Lions''' are large, carnivorous [[cat]]s.  In [[WoW]], lions are common predatory [[beast]]s in central [[Kalimdor]].  As predators, lions tend to be [[hostile]] and will attack [[player]]s who approach them.

=== Game Value ===
* [[Hunter]]s can tame lions as [[pet]]s; pet lions will [[Pet Feeding|eat]] [[meat]] and [[fish]].
* Lions are [[skinnable]].
* Several [[quest]]s require players to collect lion parts, such as claws or fangs.
